lines.t: Verse 1
Behold creation, Lord, Your wonders overflow
Galaxies unnumbered, yet Your love still shows
Father's heart in Son revealed so sweet and true
Beyond our understanding, Your light breaking through
Verse 2
Your power never ends, Your love like a warm embrace
Your glory lights the east, flows west with endless grace
Clothed in truth and mercy, love crowned on Your head
You hold all life together, by the words You’ve said
Chorus
Yahushua, Yahuwah, Forever You remain
Alpha and Omega, Your love will never change
Clothed in radiant glory, robed in endless praise
We bow before Your holiness, forever we’ll proclaim
Verse 3
Autumn leaves are painting scenes of Your gentle hand
Every breeze and flower whispers across the land
Creation’s song is rising, praising who You are
From tallest eagle soaring, to the closest star
Bridge
Kiss the Son and worship, bow before His throne
The Father and the Son forever are One
Your majesty surrounds us, in wonder we behold
The depth of all Your wisdom, Your glory untold
Chorus
Yahushua, Yahuwah, Forever You remain
Alpha and Omega, Your love will never change
Clothed in radiant glory, robed in endless praise
We bow before Your holiness, forever we’ll proclaim
Outro
Holy, Holy, Lord God Almighty
Everlasting One who is always near
We lift Your name forever
Yahushua, Yahuwah, God forever here
